aboutH2: Addiction Rehab Toronto: Private Detox and Residential Rehab in Etobicoke
intro: Addiction Rehab Toronto is one of the premier addiction treatment centres in Toronto, with a long-standing reputation for providing effective and high-quality rehabilitation services to those in need. They offer various types of addiction recovery treatments such as drug rehab, alcohol rehab, and mental health rehabilitation. If you or someone close to you needs assistance overcoming an addiction disorder, Addiction Rehab Toronto is the perfect place to begin your road back towards good health.

At Addiction Rehab Toronto, we understand addiction is a complex and serious issue. That’s why our team of experienced clinicians will work diligently to help you conquer your addiction and return to a healthy lifestyle. We offer customized treatment options tailored specifically for each individual’s needs and objectives. No matter the type of addiction you may be struggling with, we can help get back on track.

pillars.title: A Home on a Quiet Court in Etobicoke
pillars.body: ART runs out of a renovated property on Warrendale Court, a quiet residential street in Etobicoke on Toronto's west side. The centre describes about 15,000 square feet of living space split into three separate residences, so men and women live apart, with private and semi-private rooms. Outside there is a courtyard, a basketball and hockey court and a fire pit. Indoors you will find several lounges, a pool table, a movie theatre, fitness studios and a yoga and Pilates room. An on-site chef cooks three meals a day and can make vegetarian, vegan, kosher, halal or gluten-free food.

pillars.title: Sober Living, Virtual Care and Aftercare for Life
pillars.body: Lifetime aftercare is included for every client. ART holds aftercare groups on Monday and Thursday evenings, graduates can keep joining counselling sessions online through the Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program, and families have their own counselling night on Wednesdays. If you want more structure before going home, the centre runs a transitional sober living house with curfews, house meetings, random drug testing and continued one-on-one counselling. There is also a recovery guarantee: finish a 45-day program and, if you relapse, you can be re-admitted. Ask admissions to walk you through the conditions.

pillars.title: Psychiatrists, Nurses and Counsellors Under One Roof
pillars.body: Clinical Director Shalini S. and Clinical Supervisor Allen Kharlip lead the counselling team, and Lisa G, an RPN, directs nursing. The psychiatrist on the team, Dr. Sandor, is a professor of psychiatry at the University of Toronto. Several addiction physicians, a pharmacist, registered psychotherapists, social workers and certified addiction counsellors round out the staff. Recovery coaches include former Toronto Maple Leaf Jim McKenny and CTV sports anchor Joe Tilley, who has spoken publicly about his own recovery from alcohol. The centre says it keeps a 3:1 staff-to-client ratio with people on site 24/7.

overview: Established in 2012, we offer occupancy for 16 to 30 people and provide services in English. Our pricing options are as follows: 30 days for $20,000, 45 days for $26,500, 60 days for $35,000, and 90 days for $52,000. Additionally, we provide extended options for those in need. Our treatment program is tailored for men and women.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Addiction Rehab Toronto cost?
faqs.a: Estimates on the centre's recovery.com profile put a 30-day stay at about $20,000, 45 days at $26,500, 60 days at $35,000 and 90 days at $52,000 (CAD). ART's own website does not post prices, because the fee depends on the substance involved, how long you stay and if you need detox first. Admissions gives you a quote after a free, confidential phone assessment.

faqs.q: How long does the rehab process take?
faqs.a: The duration of treatment depends on the individual’s needs and progress. Programs may range from short-term stays (30 days) to long-term stays (90 days or more). Treatment plans are tailored to each client’s unique circumstances, and the length of stay will be determined in consultation with the treatment team.

faqs.q: Does Addiction Rehab Toronto offer medical detox?
faqs.a: Yes. Detox happens on site in Etobicoke, with nurses on duty around the clock, on-call physicians and medication when it is needed. Most people can start within 24 to 48 hours of a phone assessment. Once you are stable you move straight into the residential program with the same team, so there is no transfer to another facility.

faqs.q: Where is Addiction Rehab Toronto and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 4 Warrendale Court in Etobicoke, a residential neighbourhood on Toronto's west side near Highway 427. Downtown Toronto is roughly 30 minutes away by car, and Mississauga, Brampton and Pearson Airport are closer than that. Call admissions before you travel so staff can plan your arrival and intake.

faqs.q: Is the treatment program inpatient or outpatient?
faqs.a: Addiction Rehab Toronto offers both inpatient and outpatient treatment programs. Inpatient treatment involves clients residing at the facility 24/7, while outpatient treatment allows clients to attend therapy sessions while living at home or in a sober living environment.

faqs.q: What kind of aftercare support is provided by Addiction Rehab Toronto?
faqs.a: Addiction Rehab Toronto offers comprehensive aftercare support to help clients maintain sobriety and prevent relapse. This support may include ongoing therapy, support groups, 12-step meetings, and access to community resources. The facility may also assist with referrals to sober living homes, outpatient programs, and other support services as needed.

faqs.q: Is this a private centre? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, ART is a private, fee-based centre, so OHIP does not cover it. Many private and extended health plans pay for part or all of treatment, and the admissions team will check your coverage before you start. The centre takes credit cards, debit, certified cheques, direct deposit and wire transfer, and offers monthly payment plans through Medicard.

faqs.q: What types of addictions are treated at Addiction Rehab Toronto?
faqs.a: Addiction Rehab Toronto treats a wide range of addictions, including alcohol, drugs (such as opioids, cocaine, marijuana, and prescription medications), and behavioral addictions like gambling, sex etc.

faqs.q: What kind of treatments and therapies are offered at Addiction Rehab Toronto?
faqs.a: Addiction Rehab Toronto offers a variety of evidence-based treatment approaches, including individual counseling, group therapy, family therapy, cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), motivational interviewing, relapse prevention, 12-step programs, and holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art therapy.

faqs.q: Is family involvement encouraged in the treatment process?
faqs.a: Family involvement is an essential component of the recovery process. Addiction Rehab Toronto encourages family participation through family therapy sessions, educational workshops, and support groups. This involvement helps to foster understanding, rebuild trust, and promote a supportive environment for long-term recovery.

Accreditation ensures that a facility meets the highest standards of care and safety. Look for accreditation by reputable organizations such as the Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities (CARF) or the Joint Commission. Always verify the accreditation status of any rehab facility you are considering.

faqs.q: What is the cost of treatment at Addiction Rehab Toronto?
faqs.a: The cost of treatment varies depending on the chosen program, duration, and individual needs. Some insurance plans may cover a portion of the treatment costs. It is recommended to contact Addiction Rehab Toronto directly to discuss payment options, insurance coverage, and potential financial assistance programs.

Addiction Rehab Toronto is a comprehensive treatment center for individuals struggling with substance abuse and addiction. The facility provides evidence-based treatments, therapies, and support services to help clients achieve lasting recovery and maintain a healthy, substance-free lifestyle.

faqs.q: How can I learn more about Addiction Rehab Toronto or begin the admission process?
faqs.a: To learn more about Addiction Rehab Toronto or start the admission process, contact the facility directly by phone or visit their website. Their trained staff will provide information, answer questions, and guide you through the intake process.
